verdict.rationale: Every ODC instance ships a preinstalled JupyterLab server, and the docs say you open it from the Instances page, which delivers the one-step Jupyter path. SSH access is documented, so remote IDE use is possible, but no IDE-specific flow is described. Missing for 10: documented one-step VS Code/Cursor connection, independent or hands-on corroboration of the JupyterLab access flow.
